name: Gokkun! Onii-chan Milk♪ ~Punipuni Oppai na Imouto to~
original_name: ごっくん！おにーちゃんみるく♪～ぷにぷにおっぱいな妹と～
source:
One afternoon on a holiday --
Our protagonist, Mitsui Shuusuke, has left his parents' home and is living alone while attending university. His younger sister, Mitsui Hina, suddenly shows up for a visit.
When Shusuke asks what's wrong, Hina hugs him and, crying, tells him that out of curiosity, she used a magic spell she learned on the internet, and her breasts grew larger.
How can she cancel the effects of the magic... "Only my big brother i can ask to do something like this for me..." Hina said, looking depressed.
After researching the magic Hina used, he finds out that her breasts are growing as a side effect of the magic, and that drinking the semen will cure the side effect.
Hina is confused as she learns what she has to do next, but it's to restore her breasts to their original state, and more importantly, the semen belongs to her brother...
Hina blushes as she mutters these words, and Shusuke understands her feelings as he picks her up and leads her to bed...
translation:
假期的一个下午——
我们的主人公三井修介在读大学期间离开了父母的家，独自生活。他的妹妹三井雏突然来访。
当周介问怎么了时，希娜拥抱了他，哭着告诉他，出于好奇，她使用了在互联网上学到的魔法咒语，她的胸部变大了。
怎么才能取消魔法的效果…… “只有我的哥哥才能帮我做这种事……”雏菜一脸郁闷的说道。
在研究了希娜所使用的魔法后，他发现她的乳房正在增长，这是魔法的副作用，而喝精液可以治愈这种副作用。
希娜很困惑，因为她知道自己接下来要做什么，但这是让她的乳房恢复到原来的状态，更重要的是，精液是属于她哥哥的……
雏菜脸红了，嘟哝着这句话，修介明白了她的感受，把她抱起来，带到了床上……
